score_method: Rounded category means across all four actual images; all retained, none regenerated or omitted.

outputs.name: Laser-etched camera saddle
evidence: laser line density is visibly bounded to one rigid saddle
dark bronze/charcoal CMF is mature and restrained
outputs.limitation: The etched field is close to decorative guilloché but remains subordinate to hardware.

outputs.name: Micro-embossed grip rail
evidence: exposed rail texture and key integration are visible
outputs.limitation: The rail carrier is subtle and cultural linkage remains weaker than image 1.

outputs.name: IMT structural ribbon
evidence: current slab and three real camera rings remain credible
indigo CMF and warm backdrop are coherent
outputs.limitation: The generator expanded the intended narrow ribbon into an almost all-over wavy line field, violating the bounded 20% carrier and reducing restraint.

outputs.name: Micro-milled lens court
evidence: machined contours visibly follow real lens clearances
strong asymmetric court remains one rigid part
moonstone/nickel CMF looks premium without literal floral imagery
outputs.limitation: The court is visually large and the contour density approaches ornament at its outer edge.

schema_learning: Departure-proof fields improve the visibility of subtle process decisions when the carrier is a real part with enough projected area. Laser etching and micro-milled toolpaths on camera hardware outperform IMT line fields on broad rear surfaces. Add a carrier-coverage constraint expressed as one bounded physical part rather than a percentage; rear-surface patterns are prone to expanding beyond their intended zone.
